report: An employee was changing out a light on a 20-foot metal pole. The pole broke at the bottom, which caused the employee to fall approximately 20 feet down the ladder to the ground. The employee was hospitalized with fractures to the right heel and a vertebra.
osha_event: Other fall to lower level 16 to 20 feet

report: An employee was preparing formwork for the next task. He cut a 2 x 4 with a circular saw and then placed the saw on the side of a wooden sawhorse. He then walked around the sawhorse and contacted the still-moving blade. The employee sustained a laceration above the knee.
osha_event: Struck by running powered equipment  n.e.c.

report: An employee was removing a wood and brick facade in preparation for a new facade. A piece of material slipped in the strap holding it, causing the strap to pin the employee's right arm against a wall. The arm was broken.
osha_event: Caught or wedged between objects  nonrunning

report: A journeyman on ground level was removing conduit from energized gear. When he lifted the conduit, it came in contact with a live bus that caused an arc blast. The journeyman sustained burns while an apprentice on the basement level who was pushing the conduit up received an electrical shock. Both employees were hospitalized.

An employee and co-workers were moving a skid steer after dropping off material at the end of the day. As the injured employee was backing up the skid steer between two pieces of equipment, the vehicle contacted the hitch of a goose-neck trailer. The employee was hospitalized for a right hip dislocation and fracture as well as a laceration to the right thigh.
osha_event: Nonroadway collision with object other than vehicle, unspecified
